items.desc: 5 tattoo friendly bathouse (onsen) in Japan ♨️ Tattoos unfortunately arent allowed in most bathhouses in Japan, so i’ve put this list together 🫶 They all also happen to be fantastic regardless of whether you have tattoos or not. If you can’t make it to any of these, then you always have the option of getting a private bathouse! In Kusatsu Onsen, three public onsens welcome tattoos of any size: 1. Sai-no-kawara 2. Otaki-no-yu 3. Goza-no-yu #japantravel
My Japanese converse are sooo much more comfortable than overseas ones, they dont hurt all 👟#japantravel

If you love shopping in Japan, here are some simple hacks to help you save money. 🇯🇵 The Osaka amazing pass has to be one of the best value passes in Japan right now. Also you might be asking what is the catch with the discount coupons?  There is a minimum spend on some of them but most of them are fairly reasonable (like $20 to $70), so it's pretty easy to hit the threshold.  And they are mostly big chain stores, so you won’t have any trouble finding places to use them. #japantravel
